pair_calibration.basis: maximum likelihood on earlier seasons' out-of-sample predictions

failed: no binary calibration rule defined for a 3-way market yet; log loss reported
not separately scored in this record

market.reason: NHL price capture is not authorised: the repository variable NHL_PRICES is not "on" (and odds_api_sports.icehockey_nhl must be enabled in the gateway)

reasons: the NHL model has not been tested against closing prices (no licensed closing-price archive)
no verified current NHL prices are captured

moneyline.market_reason: no licensed archive of timestamped NHL closing prices is on file (hockey/market/closing/); until one is, no NHL price is called an edge

attribution: NHL game data: sportsdataverse fastRhockey (compiled from the NHL's public game feeds). sportsdataverse/fastRhockey-nhl-data and -raw are MIT-licensed repositories; the game data inside them is compiled from the NHL's public game feeds and remains the NHL's. NHL.com terms restrict commercial use of its content: the owner must review this before NHL output is sold in a paid tier. Attribution is printed on every NHL artifact.

puck_line.settles: includes overtime and shootout; an OT/SO win is a one-goal win

total.settles: includes overtime; the shootout winner is credited one goal

uncertainty.basis: spread of the home win probability and expected total across the validated variants (chosen model, goals-only, goalie-aware under each projected goalie pairing). A sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

notes: Ratios are to the league's running average (1.00 = average); xG ratings are score-adjusted and opponent-adjusted.
Ratings decay with a 180-day half-life and are shrunk toward average by a 32-game prior; early-season ratings lean on last season.

invalidators: A starting goalie other than the projected one (see the goalie scenarios for the size of the move).
A late scratch of a top-line forward or top-pair defenceman: skater availability is NOT modelled.
A price posted by a book that settles the market differently (a 60-minute line is not the 2-way moneyline).
A back-to-back: the second-game effect is in the model, but the rested starter decision is not known yet.
